heading: Thursday, January 30, 2025
topLine: Mistral releases Mistral Small 3 under Apache 2.0.

items.headline: Mistral releases Mistral Small 3 under Apache 2.0
items.summary: Mistral Small 3 is a latency-optimized 24B-parameter open-weight model released under Apache 2.0, with base and instruct checkpoints. Mistral claims over 81% on MMLU and performance competitive with Llama 3.3 70B while running more than three times faster.
